title: Count the 1 bits
task: Write the procedure popcount: a0 holds a 32-bit word; return in a0 how many of its bits are 1. Keep the calling convention.
starter:
# popcount -- practice exercise (MAVILERA)
# Return in a0 the number of 1 bits of a0.
# Hint: test the lowest bit, then shift right; srli does not copy the sign.
        .text
popcount:
        # a0 = the word
        li   a0, 0              # replace with your code
        ret
